title: nbn outage affecting Keysborough POI (VIC)
current_summary: Some nbn services connected through the Keysborough point of interconnect in Victoria were affected after a motor vehicle accident at about 12:50am on 4 November damaged some of the backhaul connections to the site. All remaining Enterprise Ethernet services have now been moved to the alternate connection, and the original damaged link has been restored, so services that were still on that link are active again. Customers whose service has not come back should power cycle their router to get a new session. We are monitoring the network to confirm services remain stable.

cause.reason: Motor vehicle accident damaged backhaul connections to the Keysborough point of interconnect
cause.detailed: A motor vehicle accident at about 12:50am AEDT on 4 November 2026 took out some backhaul services to the Keysborough point of interconnect. The site was cordoned off by police, so crews could not install a new pole and replace the damaged cables.

updates.content: We are aware of an outage affecting nbn services connected through the Keysborough point of interconnect in Victoria. Some customers in the area may be affected. Our team is investigating and we will share further details as soon as they are available.

We have identified the cause of this outage as a motor vehicle accident at about 12:50am, which damaged some of the backhaul connections to the Keysborough point of interconnect. The site is currently a police scene, so we do not yet have an estimated restoration time. We are investigating moving affected services onto another connection at the site and will update you as soon as we have more information.

Progress has been made in restoring services. Services have been moved to a new connection at the Keysborough point of interconnect, and many customers should be coming back online. If your service has not restored, please power cycle your router to get a new session. Some other services are still being moved and are waiting on action from nbn. We do not yet have an estimated time for full restoration and will update you as this progresses.

We have escalated the changes needed to move the remaining services onto the new connection with nbn and are waiting on their update. The original damaged backhaul link is still down. The site was cordoned off by police, so crews could not install a new pole and replace the damaged cables. If your service has not restored, please power cycle your router to get a new session. We still do not have an estimated restoration time and will update you as this progresses.

We are continuing to work with nbn on moving the remaining Enterprise Ethernet services onto the new connection at the Keysborough point of interconnect, and there is still no estimated restoration time. The carrier for the damaged link has advised that, because the site is under investigation by authorities, access to install a new pole and cabling may not be available until about 9pm tonight (4 November). If your service has not restored, please power cycle your router to get a new session. We will update you as we receive more information.

Work has begun to re-run the cable for the damaged link at the Keysborough point of interconnect. It is expected to be completed overnight, with an estimated restoration time of 7am on 5 November. The move of the remaining Enterprise Ethernet services to the alternate connection is still being worked on by nbn. If your service has not restored, please power cycle your router to get a new session. We will update you as this progresses.

Service has been restored. All Enterprise Ethernet services have now been moved to the alternate connection at the Keysborough point of interconnect, and the original damaged link has also been restored, so services that remained on it are active again. If your service has not come back, please power cycle your router to get a new session. We will continue to monitor and confirm once this outage is fully resolved.
